payload.title: Hub monitor records feed the Knowledge Map as data
payload.description: As the editor of a site with a Hugging Face Hub monitor, I want the monitor's models to count in the weekly Knowledge Map (clusters, entities, weekly trends, built-on relations) without becoming site pages, so that Cited Trends can see what the Hub released and I can promote the notable ones to real items with approval. Opt-in site setting knowledgeRun.monitorSources: [huggingface]. Corpus-sync exports monitor-delivered References (any state except rejected) as monitor-record documents dated by createdAt; entities come deterministically from the Hub fields (maker, licence, task, model); base models import as built_on relations (subtype kept) with the Hub card as evidence and no AI review; ideas trends cites records; papyrus references promote creates a draft item; the weekly run report suggests top records in one soft review request. Out of scope: AI extraction for records, platform entity links, deploying anything.
